author: PokerFace
body:
Hello everyone,
I have made a new map and, it carries a similar theme from 2 other maps that are somewhat similar but not earlier versions of this map as this one was made completely from scratch. Well here it is, I have been working on this for 3-4 months and I hope it paid off. Feedback is appreciated so I will wait a week before providing a download link and yml. 

[DTM] Opulence:
  • Player Count- 25v25 (or more)
  • Monument Count- 5 (per side)
Pictures: https://imgur.com/a/jhi7t



Download Link: 

YML: http://pastebin.com/C57jhvT5
(Courtesy of AmazeModerating and Darkye_)

Credentials: 

I would like to thank alexanderjoe10 for being the server host once again.

I would also like to thank Awesomerp for some
minor tweaks. 

NinjaBridge also made a few walls. Thanks for teaching me the /pt /paste trick!

Notes: 

If you for some odd reason would like to see my previous maps that carried a similar theme, you can find them in links below. 

Cetacea: https://avicus.net/forums/4d71230c3
Leviathan: https://avicus.net/forums/72cf153a5

Alright, thanks for everyone's support! Again, feedback is appreciated. Also, I thought this was kind of funny but, Zedther said he roamed my map for hours when it was being built xD.

replies.author: Tpk42
replies.body:
I like the overall aesthetics of the map, it kinda reminds me of playing cards, which would be a really cool theme!

My only comment would be the center. It kinda just crunches together in the middle, which can take away from the whole free roaming thing, which i really like as well. 

I would say connect the two sides with something more than just that center area. Overall one of the best ideas I've seen so far, just needs that one little tweak.

replies.body:
Well I was kind of thinking since this is a huge map, the number of people fighting in the middle will be relatively low as you would have to travel some distance to reach the center. I had the map tested yesterday and, the fight in the center was actually fun. Sure you might die a few times but once you get across, there's the real fun.

If it somehow happens to turn into a long standoff, I will implement your suggestion. Thanks!
